title: Alden review draft (a comment waiting to be sent)

headSha.description: the PR's head commit the draft's line refers to

path.description: the file of an inline comment; absent for a general note, which goes into the review's body

line.description: the line, on `side`; the last line of a multi-line comment; absent for a general note

startLine.description: a multi-line comment's first line, on the same side and in the same hunk; always less than `line`

side.description: RIGHT: the line in the new file (added or unchanged); LEFT: in the old file (removed)

body.description: the comment, in Markdown; may be empty when the draft has a suggestion

suggestion.description: replacement code for the commented line(s), posted as a ```suggestion block after the body; empty deletes them. Only on the new side (RIGHT). On a linked note it can't be applied, so it posts as a code block headed "Suggested change"

originalLines.description: the text of the commented line(s) when the draft was placed: what a suggestion replaces

linkTo.description: on a general note: the line (or lines, or file) it's about, outside the PR's diff. It posts in the review body with a link to that code at `headSha`, the PR's head when it was written. Absent on an inline comment and a plain note

path.description: the file, as in the repo at the draft's head commit

line.description: the line (a range's last line); absent for a whole file

startLine.description: a range's first line, less than `line`; absent for one line

source.description: who wrote it: you, Claude Code drafting for you, or Alden drafting from its model's finding (until you keep or edit it, when it becomes yours)

drafted.description: on a comment Alden drafted: the finding it came from. Kept after you keep or edit it, for learning

checkId.description: the check of the finding it was drafted from: "model" for the model's own

inReplyTo.description: a reply: the review thread's GraphQL node id. A reply has no path or line of its own; it posts in that thread with the review

resolve.description: on a reply: resolve the thread once the review is sent

state.description: outdated: the PR moved on and the line couldn't be found again, so it can't be sent until it's placed

changedIn.description: on an outdated draft, as the local API lists it: the PR's head commit its lines no longer match at. Absent when GitHub couldn't be reached

movedTo.description: on an outdated draft, as the local API lists it: where its code reads most like it now, to move it there (PATCH it with this place). Absent when nothing is close enough or two places are equally close: pick a line

line.description: the line (a range's last line) at the PR's head

startLine.description: a range's first line, less than `line`
